# FDN Consuming Aberration.
# "Consuming Aberration's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your
# opponents' graveyards."  M21 Kinetic Augur's characteristic-defining SET_PT static (B5b), both
# halves, counting every card in the opponents' graveyards (Zone(GRAVEYARD, OPPONENT): every
# opponent's).
# "Whenever you cast a spell, each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they
# reveal a land card, then puts those cards into their graveyard."  "A spell" is
# CastSpellEvent(FAnd(())) (MAPPER_GUIDE); each opponent in turn (EachPlayer(ALL_OPPONENTS), M21
# Thieves' Guild Enforcer's form, "you" inside is that opponent) reveals until a land (M21
# Transmogrify's REVEAL until), then every revealed card goes to the graveyard: an ALL over the
# revealed window at the library top (MAPPER_GUIDE "All of the revealed cards").
GY_COUNT = QCount(
    selector=Selector(
        count=QUnbounded(),
        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),),
    ),
)
size = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.SET_PT, {
        'power': GY_COUNT,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': GY_COUNT,
    }),
)
feed = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=EachPlayer(
        ref=ControllerRef.ALL_OPPONENTS,
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.REVEAL, {
                    'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
                    'count': QConst(value=1),
                    'until': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
                }),
                A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QUnbounded(),
                        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(
                            Zone(
                                kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY,
                                controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                                position=ZonePosition.TOP,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [size, feed, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Consuming Aberration's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your opponents' graveyards.
Whenever you cast a spell, each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then puts those cards into their graveyard.
